body: farm mud fills one crease of the black umbrella and camera; clean warning tape seals the opposite crease.
title: Black umbrella with the second residue
gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.

body: A grounds notebook marks a test strip along the course edge; a handwritten note asks players to keep their shoes out of the drainage ditch.
title: The second fairway note
gloss: A test strip and a shoe warning share the course grounds log.
rival_reading: A response team could mark off a ditch during a cleanup; the note does not identify what was applied to the strip.
